data.sql: INSERT INTO planets(sector_id,name,owner_id,owner_type,class,population,population_type,type,created_by,colonists_unassigned,colonists_ore,colonists_org,colonists_eq,colonists_weapons,slave_unrest_next_at,slave_unrest_stopped,slave_unrest_stoppage_until) SELECT 1,'v3_cfg03_disabled_qa',player_id,'player','M',20,'SLAVE',pt.planettypes_id,player_id,0,10,5,3,2,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM NOW())::bigint-1,FALSE,NULL FROM players CROSS JOIN planettypes pt WHERE players.name='System' AND pt.code='V3_CFG03_QA';

tests.name: Run authoritative unrest handler with zero-valued defaults
Zero defaults produce no active stoppage or population-loss event

data.sql: SELECT (population=20 AND population_type='SLAVE' AND NOT slave_unrest_stopped AND colonists_unassigned=0 AND colonists_ore=10 AND colonists_org=5 AND colonists_eq=3 AND colonists_weapons=2)::int,(SELECT COUNT(*)=0 FROM planet_slave_unrest_events e WHERE e.planet_id=p.planet_id)::int FROM planets p WHERE name='v3_cfg03_disabled_qa';
